verdicts.reason: Quotes verified verbatim. 06.02.01-teacher-tuition-profile.md:67 ratifies intake status `waitlist` whose page effect is "CTA becomes \"Join waitlist\"", and :186 (States, Books-closed) makes that CTA normative ("the CTA changes rather than disappears"), backed by D-05 at :239. Nothing in 06.02.01, the 06.02 index or the 06.02 CX defines what joining does. Against that, 06.01.01-lesson-slot-booking-recurring-series.md:244 (Q-01) states "No waitlist node exists anywhere in domain 06 ... new scope, not a deferral" with owner User and target `/evolve-feature`, and 06.02.03-teacher-discovery-match-criteria.md:305 (D-08) and :316 (Q-03) both say partition 3 is resolved "deliberately **without a waitlist**" / "without any waitlist". A ratified profile CTA that two ratified decisions say is out-of-scope machinery is a genuine unmarked divergence: implementer A ships the control, implementer B omits it. DOWNGRADED from blocking because the auditor overstates two supporting points. (a) The ladder floor is reconcilable: 06.02.03:136 reads "Waitlist / **notify-me**" and :266 lists it as a CX-M07 dependency ("the waitlist/notify at relaxation step 10, which must decay and go quiet") — a criteria-level saved-search alert satisfies step 10 and the Exhausted state at :227 without any per-teacher waitlist, so D-08 and step 10 do not actually collide. (b) The claimed card-level conflict is wrong: 06.02.01:67's Match-effect column says only "Ranked, labelled", not a CTA on the result card, so it does not contradict D-08's "No trial CTA" on partition 3. The residue — one un-re-pointed CTA string against a tracked `/evolve-feature` deferral — is a warning, not a blocker.

Quotes verified. 06.01.02-lesson-packages-credits-rate-cards.md:200 (edge 12) mandates the copy "Credits are with {teacher}. To stop lessons with them, request a refund" — "with the refund path stated, not hidden". A repo-wide grep for "refund" across all of domain 06 confirms the word appears in only one tuition file (06.01.02) plus course-side files; :150-159 scopes the remedy flow strictly to teacher departure, :78's `granted ──refund──> refunded` transition carries no trigger condition, and edge 25 (:213) specifies routing only ("a refund is due"), never eligibility. So the mandated copy promises a path no file defines. DOWNGRADED from blocking on two grounds the finding did not check. (1) The refundability axis IS tracked one level up: 06.01-lesson-booking-packages-delivery-index.md:71 (Q-01) still carries the unnarrowed framing — "Are lesson credits **money** (refundable, a stored-value liability) or **entitlements** (non-refundable, expiring)?" — owner User, target `/create-prd-security`, mirrored at education-lessons-mentorship-index.md:126 (domain Q-07). The finding only rebutted 06.01.02's own narrowed Q-01. (2) The series-termination half is largely answered: 06.01.01:162/230 (At Risk → Lapsed on non-payment) and :151-168 give a defined exit for an abandoned series, so "no way to end a series" overstates. What survives is real and untracked: present-tense user copy promising a refund route with no eligibility rule, fee, or slot-release consequence anywhere in the domain.

The reconciliation sits in the sentence immediately after the auditor's own quote, and was omitted. 06.01.02-lesson-packages-credits-rate-cards.md:143-145 reads: "This feature owns the signal and its timing. Whether a zero balance **suspends** or **releases** the standing slot is 06.01.01's call ... and is not decided here; the ledger's contribution is that the teacher's forward book and the student's slot risk are both visible **before the balance hits zero, not after**." That is an explicit warning-tier/state-tier split — exactly what the finding asserts the files are not. 06.01.02 owns an early at-risk *signal* (≤2 credits / 21-day projection) on the pack ledger; 06.01.01:162 and D-03 at :230 own the series *state* at balance 0 that starts the 2-occurrence / 14-day release clock. Both are implementable together and the release clock is unambiguously anchored to zero balance by D-03, so the claimed two-occurrence divergence in tenancy release cannot arise from a competent reading.

All four quotes verified, but the cited 06.01.02 text carries its own resolution pointer. 06.01.02-lesson-packages-credits-rate-cards.md:223 (edge 35) states the limbo outcome is "**pending 06.01.03's rule (their Q-03)**" — it explicitly disclaims ownership and names the exact question id. Following that pointer gives 06.01.03-cancellation-makeup-no-show-policy.md:268: "Q-03 ... **RESOLVED** ... the credit returns, no signal on either party", ratified at DT-09 (:213) and rendered at :144 ("credit returns, no signal either side") and :179 (repeats flag the series as possibly off-platform). 06.01.04-lesson-delivery-session-record.md:246 does the same thing — it defers the ledger effect to 06.01.03 rather than deciding. Divergence therefore requires ignoring an explicit same-sentence cross-reference to the named owner. What remains is stale interim wording in a deferring file, below warning threshold.

Quotes verified (06.01.03:178 and :227 do route the serial-late-canceller pattern to a stale 06.01.01 Q-01 framing, and 06.01.01:181 DT-08 rejects that lever with D-03 at :230). But the predicted failure — an implementer building a per-student missed-lesson counter with a reclaim action — is foreclosed twice, once inside the very file that carries the stale pointer. 06.01.03-cancellation-makeup-no-show-policy.md:218 (DT-12) rejects student attendance records "❌ REJECTED — it violates the domain's own law ... An accumulating 'you have missed 3 lessons' record is exactly that pattern", and :263 (D-17) plus the cross-cut note at :230 ("Student-side reliability is **rejected outright** (DT-12) — a hard boundary") repeat it. 06.01.01:142 independently rules the squatting case out ("No countermeasure needed, deliberately"). Every reasonable reading converges on 'no miss counter'; the defect is a stale question id, not a divergence.

Both CX statements are verified verbatim (06.01-lesson-booking-packages-delivery-cx.md:134-140 and :105) and both are stale — but both are explicitly answered by ratified decisions that name the CX ids themselves, so nothing is left to invent or diverge over. 06.01.01-lesson-slot-booking-recurring-series.md:230 (D-03) states: "Also answers sub-domain **CX-06** (`[PARTIAL]` — does a zero balance suspend or release?): **both, in that order, with a stated date**", and :202 declares the note supersedes the face-value CX reading. The CX-04 waitlist-promotion line is closed at :235 (D-08, "No waitlist auto-promotion ... Backfill is achieved with no waitlist machinery at all") and at :182 (DT-09, rejected). The residual `[PENDING]` role-scoping line is a Medium-confidence CX entry under the file's own stated template rule ("Synthesis questions: Deferred — Medium confidence, per the CX template's rule"), and role coverage for this seam exists in the sub-domain Role Matrix and each child's Role Lens. Stale-marker hygiene, not an implementable gap.

All five rows exist as quoted, but four of the five already have their answer or a live secondary target, which collapses the claimed 'no route to resolution'. (1) 06.04.02-course-catalog-pricing-enrollment.md Q-01 (which pricing models ship) is answered by that file's own D-02 at :124 — "**One-off purchase** is the launch model; subscription is later" — and restated in Q-03 ("launch is one-off only (D-02), so it does not block this feature"), directly refuting the failure scenario about subscription entitlements. (2) 06.04 index Q-03 (certificates) is answered by the pass it defers to: moscow-ledger.md:727 bands 06.08 Certificates, Badges & Verification in the **WONT** section. (3) 06.04.02 Q-04 (courses as first slice) is answered by the same ledger (06.04.* all SHOULD at :273-275 vs 06.01.* MUST at :63-66) and is carried live at domain Q-03 → `/plan-phase`, as 06.04 index Q-04 itself records. (4) 06.04.03-course-consumption-completion.md:63 tracks offline download as `[PENDING — MoSCoW / **/create-prd-security**]`, i.e. with a live target, not a dead one. Only 06.04 index Q-01 (open vs curated) points solely at the closed pass, and it still names an owner (User). One stale target out of five does not sustain the finding.

Quotes verified, but the Role Lens tables are stance descriptions, not entitlement gates, and the domain says so explicitly. education-lessons-mentorship-index.md:107 (D-02) ratifies "the Role Lens handles teacher/student **contextually** — no split", and 06.01.02-lesson-packages-credits-rate-cards.md:32 applies exactly this rule to the mirror case: "A Fan who wants lessons is acting as a Musician (student) and **is lensed as one from that moment**". 06.04.03-course-consumption-completion.md:23 settles the buyer case outright — "Fan | Full | Consumes what they bought, **exactly as any learner. No distinction, and no reason for one.**" — and its D-05 at :109 keys access to the entitlement ("Consumption is gated on the **entitlement**"). 06.04.02 grants the Producer `Full` on the buy/enroll feature and notes "No persona is **None** here". No competent implementer gates playback on a persona label against an entitlement the same sub-domain says is the gate; the locked-out-paying-customer scenario does not arise.

Quotes verified, but the pending marker and the resolution issue the *same* instruction, so the predicted failure is impossible. 06.03.05-progress-reports-skill-tracking.md:37-39 ends with "...and **inventing a skill taxonomy at breadth would be fabrication**" — which is precisely the outcome Q-02 (:106, "**RESOLVED — no, there is not**") and D-03 (:98, "measures **coverage**, never **musicianship**") exist to prevent. A reader who obeys the marker and a reader who obeys the decision both ship no skill taxonomy. The alternative failure (blocking the shard) is foreclosed by the file's normative D-03 and by domain Q-08 being closed on the identical question, which 06.04.03 Q-04 (:120) also cites. The 06.03 CX-07 bare `[PENDING]` role-scoping line sits under the file's own stated convention ("Synthesis questions: Deferred — Medium confidence, per the CX template's rule", :151/:169) and duplicates coverage already in the sub-domain Role Matrix. Stale status wording only.

Quotes verified, but the observable behaviour is fully pinned, leaving the unstated allowance size with no user-visible consequence. 06.03.03-practice-logging-streaks-goals.md:60 forbids the loss event, :58 forbids "broken-streak drama", and the Recovered state at :76 specifies the render exhaustively: "the lapse renders as a neutral gap in the week strip and a return prompt — 'Good to see you back' — **with no zeroed counter and no loss-framed alert**. This state exists precisely so the lapse is a resume point, not a quit trigger." Under that rule both of the auditor's implementers produce identical output — a neutral gap, no reset — so the freeze size is not a decision with divergent outcomes. The on/off half is a tracked deferral: Q-03 (:116) carries owner User and cites domain D-04 as the ratified values half, with only 'is the optional surface built at all' outstanding.

Quotes verified at education-lessons-mentorship-cx.md:231, :274, :287 and :302, but each seam's real gate is tracked with an owner and a live target in its owning file. CX-08 names 06.07 Q-01, which at 06.07-learning-paths.md:112 is `[OWNER]`, User-owned and explicitly re-pointed; CX-10 names 06.06 Q-01, which at 06.06-mentorship-programmes.md:112 carries its own re-pointed target; CX-11's object boundary is 06.05 Q-03, re-pointed at 06.05-group-lessons-workshops-masterclasses.md:121 to `/create-prd-architecture`; CX-12's substance is stated completely in its own Relationship paragraph and its level-taxonomy limit is ratified at 06.02.03 D-02/D-06. The bare `[PENDING]` on role scoping accompanies "Synthesis questions: Deferred — **Medium confidence**" in every case, which the tree states is the CX template's own rule for non-High entries — a documented convention, not a lost decision. Role coverage for the named surfaces already exists in 06.02.03's Role Lens and Restricted state (minors-facing search) and the domain Role Matrix, so no spec writer is left inventing role scoping.

Quotes verified (06.02.04-trial-lessons-conversion.md:20 grants the monthly cap; :27-28 enumerates only three differences; no cap-exhausted state at :67-75). But the three claimed builds do not survive contact with the rest of the tree. Queueing requests past the cap is a per-teacher waitlist, which 06.01.01 Q-01 (:244) and 06.02.03 D-08 (:305) both put outside scope; an advisory-only cap contradicts the word 'caps'. That leaves exactly one consistent build — suppress the trial offer — and its copy is already specified at :70: "Empty | Teacher offers no trials | 'This teacher doesn't offer trials — book a first lesson at {rate}'. Not an error", which is also what 06.02.03's result card falls back to. The residue the auditor lists (calendar month vs rolling 30 days, whether a cancelled trial returns the allowance) is contract-shaped detail for `/write-be-spec`, the same layer 06.02.04 Q-04 already routes penalty weighting to.

The two statements are compatible, and the scoping that makes them compatible is inside the auditor's own quote. 06.02.02-verified-credentials-credit-backed-credibility.md:305 (D-03) bans "no completeness nudge **for credits**" — credits being precisely the evidence kind the teacher cannot add (D-01: the block is not authorable; credits arrive from domain 02). The Role Lens at :34 grants "a private 'what's thin' view listing **evidence they could add**", and the Role Lens's own items (a) enumerate what is addable: qualifications and a DBS/background check submitted for verification, plus an academy vouch. Edge case :211 shows the permitted teacher-facing prompt in practice ("3 credits aren't confirmed yet. Ask someone who was there"), and :212 fixes the protected case ("an explanation of the ceiling, never a deficiency marker"). The sibling profile decision 06.02.01 D-11 (:249) establishes the same permitted shape platform-wide — "No completeness score. **Named missing items with concrete effects**, dismissible". A view listing addable evidence kinds while never rendering credit absence satisfies both.

Quotes verified (education-lessons-mentorship-index.md:13 and :113; 06.03.03:85; 06.02.03:308). But no implementation decision branches on a KPI threshold, so nothing is invented and nothing diverges — the objection is to strategic rationale prose in an index, not to a spec item. D-08's condition is in fact stated and testable in structural terms, not left directional: "conditionally confirmed (a) — but **only if practice is a byproduct of a practice tool rather than self-reported** (06.03.03 DT-01), which is why 06.03.04 was added", and that condition is tracked as a live owner question at 06.03.03 Q-01 (detected vs reported). 06.02.03 D-11 names the metric and its rationale; attaching a numeric target is an owner/business decision the tree consistently routes to `/create-prd` (06.02.03 records its weights as "platform defaults, owner-overridable at `/create-prd`"). Target-setting is a later-layer artifact, not an ideation-layer ambiguity.
